methodology: Freshness describes observation age only. It is not a confidence score, accuracy guarantee, source-quality rating or automatic collection schedule.

current.label: Current
current.meaning: Source observation checked 0–7 UTC calendar days ago.

aging.label: Aging
aging.meaning: Source observation checked 8–30 UTC calendar days ago; review priority is increasing.

stale.label: Stale
stale.meaning: Source observation checked more than 30 UTC calendar days ago; re-verification is recommended before relying on changing market fields.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.meaning: No valid sourceChecked date is available. Missing age never becomes zero or current.

hardRules: Fresh does not mean guaranteed correct.
Freshness does not replace source provenance.
A freshness state does not imply a background collector exists.
Different fields may eventually require different collection cadences; this v1.0 policy evaluates the admitted observation date only.
